The tool used to clean teeth is a toothbrush.

Regarding Derek's symptoms, a persistent dry cough lasting more than three weeks combined with new-onset shortness of breath (dyspnea) on exertion suggests several potential medical conditions. These could include respiratory issues such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), or post-infectious cough. It could also indicate cardiac problems like heart failure, which often presents with exertional dyspnea. Other possibilities include pulmonary embolism, interstitial lung disease, or side effects from certain medications (such as ACE inhibitors). Given the duration and the addition of breathing difficulties, it is important for Derek to seek medical evaluation to determine the underlying cause.
